question: Which weather phenomenon is defined as the movement of large-scale winds around a central region of high atmospheric pressure?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anticyclone**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​__The weather phenomenon **defined as the movement of large-scale winds** around a central region of high atmospheric pressure **is called an anticyclone.**
 
• They are associated with **high atmospheric pressure at their center. ​**
 
• In the** Northern Hemisphere**, winds in an anticyclone rotate clockwise, while in the **Southern Hemisphere** they rotate counterclockwise. 
 
• **Anticyclones** are often associated with clear skies and dry conditions. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**
